finding_semantics: Confirm/dismiss refers to original evidenced defect; resolution separately tracked. Blockerfalse only means source fix implemented, NOT verified release readiness. Independently assess fixes and deny readiness if insufficient evidence/new blockers.

findings.title: Dirty channel navigation guard occurs after global config mutation
findings.fix_summary: Global router beforeEach guard precedes configInit; cancelled header restores selection.

findings.title: Stale save continuation crosses document/channel generations
Keyboard edits remain possible during save
findings.fix_summary: Native disabled+inert fieldset and disabled dialog metadata.

findings.title: Abandoned legacy editor lookup redirects new route
Template temporary on-air badges never refresh
findings.fix_summary: Poll temporary list with channel bindings.

findings.title: Fullframe resize handles clipped by canvas overflow
findings.fix_summary: Move handles inside bounds; focused desktop/mobile regression.

findings.title: Active library filter has no visual feedback
Resize handles lack keyboard action and layer selection semantic state
findings.fix_summary: Arrow resizing on handle; aria-pressed selection.

findings.title: First image cannot reset old target and stale data mapping remains on former layer
findings.fix_summary: ActualfirstimageID; prune former-layer data mapping evenifsharedplaceholder remains elsewhere.

findings.title: Combined role+content save validates old role and partially persists changes
findings.fix_summary: Optional atomicassignment payload validated against effective new role, single DBtransaction content+bindings+displaced permanent; old omittedpayload unchanged.

findings.title: Waiting takes cannot be cancelled when active list empty
findings.fix_summary: Alwaysavailableall-out clears active and pending takes; noactive requirement.
